transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… I’m here because I’m not really eating much lately. Some days it’s just coffee, maybe a piece of bread. My clothes are getting loose.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, or do you not get pleasure from them anymore?
Yeah… I guess so. I used to like walking by the lake, and I’d work on these little model kits. Now they just kind of sit there. I look at them and… it feels like they belong to somebody else.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
Yeah… I’m barely eating. Most days it’s just coffee, maybe a little bread. And my pants are loose now, so… I guess I’ve lost weight.
How long have you been feeling this way lately?
About… five months, I think. It’s been hanging around that long.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past several months?
Yeah… most days. I wake up and it’s just this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Like there’s nothing good waiting, so I just… keep my head down.
Have you been blaming yourself for things or feeling like you’re a failure, maybe even worthless at times?
Yeah… I do. I keep thinking I’m no good. Losing that job… and now my relatives having to help me… it just makes me feel like I ruined everything. I go over mistakes in my head a lot.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things, or is this the first time you've felt this way?
I… I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had bad times before, but I don’t know if it was like this. I don’t really keep track.
Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time before this one when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble enjoying what you used to?
I don’t know… maybe. I can’t really remember it clear enough. I’ve had rough stretches, but I don’t know if I lost interest in things like you’re asking.
Can you recall if there was ever a time before these past five months when you felt down most days, stopped enjoying things, or lost interest in activities for a period of at least two weeks?
I can’t really say. I know I’ve had bad spells before, but I don’t remember if it was every day like that or for two weeks. It’s kind of blurry.
Can you remember if there was ever a time before these past five months when you felt down most days, stopped enjoying things, or lost interest in activities for a period of at least two weeks?
I really don’t remember it that clearly. I’ve had times where I felt bad, yeah, but whether it was most days for two weeks… I can’t say.
Can you remember if there was ever a time before these past five months when you felt down most days, stopped enjoying things, or lost interest in activities for a period of at least two weeks?
I know you’ve asked, but… I just don’t remember it well enough. There were rough times before, but I can’t say if it was most days or lasted two weeks.
Can you remember if there was ever a time before these past five months when you felt down most days, stopped enjoying things, or lost interest in activities for a period of at least two weeks?
I don’t know… I can’t pin it down like that. I remember feeling low before, but not enough to say it was most days or exactly two weeks.
Can you remember if there was ever a time before these past five months when you felt down most days, stopped enjoying things, or lost interest in activities for a period of at least two weeks?
I’m sorry, I just… I don’t remember well enough to say yes or no. Before these last months it’s kind of blurry.
Can you remember if there was ever a time before these past five months when you felt down most days, stopped enjoying things, or lost interest in activities for a period of at least two weeks?
I really can’t say. It’s all kind of mixed up before this… I don’t remember it clear enough to say it was two weeks or most days.

Can you remember if there was ever a time before these past five months when you had a period of feeling down most days, losing interest in things, or not enjoying activities — and that period lasted for at least two weeks — and that happened more than once, with times in between when you felt better for a while?
I don’t really know. I can’t remember it in that kind of pattern… like more than once with breaks. Before recently it’s just not clear to me.

Can you remember if there was ever a time, more than once, when you felt down most days and lost interest in things for a couple of weeks or more — and between those times you felt better for a while, maybe even months?
I don’t know… I can’t really place it like that. Maybe there were bad stretches, but I don’t remember them clearly enough to say it happened more than once or that I was better for months in between.

Can you remember if there was ever a time, more than once, when you felt down most days and lost interest in things for a couple of weeks or more — and between those times you felt better for a while, maybe even months?
I already... I just don’t remember it that clearly. I can’t say if it was more than once or if there were months where I was really better. It’s kind of blurred together.

Can you remember if there was ever a time, more than once, when you felt down most days and lost interest in things for a couple of weeks or more — and between those times you felt better for a while, maybe even months?
I don’t know… I feel like I already can’t separate it out like that. It’s hard for me to say there were clear times it happened and then months where I was better. I just don’t remember it that way.

Can you remember if there were times in the past, more than once, when you felt down most days and lost interest in things for a couple of weeks or longer, and in between those times you actually felt better for a while—like for weeks or months?

I’m not really sure. I know I’ve had rough times, but I can’t pin it down like that… whether it was more than once, or if I was actually better for weeks or months in between. It all kind of runs together.

Can you remember if there were times in the past, more than once, when you felt down most days and lost interest in things for a couple of weeks or longer, and in between those times you actually felt better for a while—like for weeks or months?
I can’t really say. I know I’ve had times where I was low, but the weeks or months in between… I don’t remember it clear enough to answer that.
